title: New cash orders never appear on the kitchen board; it says 'No active orders' while they wait as Pending on another page
steps: Sign in as tenant-a-user, open Kitchen, select Brixton Village Grill
In a separate guest context place a cash collection order at /shop/brixton-village-grill
expected: The new order appears on the kitchen board (or the board says an order is waiting for confirmation)
actual: Board stays 'Live — No active orders. Orders will appear here when customers place them' for 70 s; the order is PENDING on the Orders page and only reaches the board after someone taps Confirm there. At 768px the Confirm button is off-screen to the right; within 3 minutes the order had slid to page 2 ('Showing 21-40 of 109') under concurrent traffic. Board only renders CONFIRMED/PREPARING/READY (KITCHEN_STATUSES).
realWorldImpact: An untrained kitchen hand sees a calm 'Live, nothing to cook' screen while customers' orders wait; the customer arrives to nothing cooked and walks to Just Eat.

title: A double-tap on 'Start Preparing' jumps the order straight to READY and emails the customer 'Ready!' the same second, with no undo
steps: Have a CONFIRMED order on the board
Check the order status via API and the customer's Mailhog inbox
expected: The second tap is ignored (debounce/disabled while in flight) or an undo is offered
actual: Server status READY (3/3: tablet 1024 and phone 360). The button under the finger becomes 'Mark Ready' optimistically and takes the second tap. Customer received 'Being Prepared' and 'Ready! ... please pick it up' emails at 22:12:53 in the same second. No undo control exists.
realWorldImpact: Customer is told food is ready before it is cooked, turns up, waits, complains; with no undo the ticket state stays wrong.

title: The customer's order note (e.g. 'severe peanut allergy') is not shown on the kitchen screen ticket
steps: Place a guest order with notes 'TUN-test: no sesame, ring bell twice'
Read the ticket on the kitchen board
expected: Notes are prominent on the kitchen card
actual: Card shows allergen banner, name, items only; notes are absent from the screen card (page.tsx renders no order.notes) although GET /api/v1/orders/kitchen returns them and the PRINTED ticket (kitchen-ticket.tsx) includes them.
realWorldImpact: Customers write allergies and special requests in the notes field; a kitchen working from the screen never sees them — allergic-reaction risk and remakes.

title: Every kitchen ticket shows only 'ORD-…' — the unique part of the order number is cut off
steps: Open the board with tickets at 360, 768 or 1024 px width
expected: A short readable order number/suffix (e.g. 70311A26) the customer can quote
actual: Heading text 'ORD-00000000-20261003-4805B9F3' (318px) is clipped to 56-64px, rendering 'ORD-...' on every ticket
realWorldImpact: Staff can't match a customer's quoted number to a ticket or call orders out; wrong bags handed over.

title: The 'non-admin' kitchen login is a tenant-wide GROUP_ADMIN: it can change prices, add outbound webhooks, grant staff and edit customers
expected: A kitchen hand can only read and bump tickets for his shop
actual: staff/me → groupAdmin:true (JIT grant, strict-scoping off by default). Product create 201 / reprice 200 / delete 204; webhook create 201 and a delivery was already attempted (consecutiveFailures:1) before revoke; staff grant 201 / revoke 204; customer create 201 / delete 204; all customers with email+phone readable. By code, DELETE /orders/{id} (SHOP_MANAGER) is also allowed — not executed. Refund, finance, GDPR export, onboarding approvals correctly 403.
realWorldImpact: Any staff login the owner hands out can reprice the menu, stream all orders to an outside server, add staff, or delete orders — the owner has to understand JIT grants to prevent it.

title: When the all-day tablet's session lapses, the kitchen board silently becomes a sign-in page and later orders are never seen
steps: Sign in on a tablet, open Kitchen
End that browser's own Keycloak session (OIDC end-session with its id_token_hint — what ssoSessionMaxLifespan does)
Keep placing+confirming orders every ~100 s and watch
expected: A loud, unmissable 'signed out — board stopped' state (sound, red screen) and a return to Kitchen after re-login; ideally a session long enough for a shift
actual: Board worked until the 5-min access token expired, then the 60-s poll got 401 and the page navigated to the generic 'Vendor sign in' page with no sound or explanation; order ORD-…7E355E89 placed afterwards was never seen (4+ min on sign-in page). Re-login lands on /dashboard, not Kitchen. Realm template sets ssoSessionMaxLifespan=7200 (2 h) — live value not read (SUSPECTED). It does NOT freeze while showing 'Live' (good).
realWorldImpact: Mid-service the kitchen screen goes quiet; nobody in a loud kitchen notices a login page; orders pile up until a customer complains.

title: Mute survives sign-out, and the next person's speaker icon shows sound ON while new orders make no beep
steps: User 1 taps the speaker to mute, signs out
User 2 signs in on the same tablet, opens Kitchen
expected: Mute cleared on sign-out, or at least the icon reflects the real state
actual: kds-muted=true survives sign-out. Button title 'Mute alerts' with volume-2 icon (sound on) but no AudioContext is created for the new order (silent). One tap leaves the icon unchanged and sets storage to false (unmutes). Control arm (kds-muted=false) beeps and toggles correctly. Cause consistent with useState(localStorage) initializer vs SSR markup (hydration attribute mismatch).
realWorldImpact: The next shift believes alerts are on, hears nothing, and misses orders; tapping to 'fix' it appears to do nothing.

title: Kitchen board lists newest first, so the longest-waiting ticket sinks below the fold
steps: Look at the board at 1024x768 and 768x1024
expected: Oldest (most urgent) first, or a clear age ordering
actual: Sorted by createdAt desc; at 1024x768 zero tickets fully above the fold (first bump button y=716), at 768 portrait 2 of 9
realWorldImpact: The order that has waited longest is the one nobody sees; long waits, cold food.

title: With Wi-Fi up but the API unreachable, the board says 'Live' for ~50 s while silently dropping an order the socket announced
steps: Kitchen open; block HTTP to :9090 (socket untouched, navigator.onLine true)
Watch the pill and board for 100 s, then restore
expected: A frame announcing an order that can't be loaded flips the board to a warning at once
actual: Socket frame advanced 'Last updated' and the pill stayed 'Live' while the /detail fetch failed silently; 'Orders are not refreshing' appeared only at ~58 s; order showed 8 s after the API returned
realWorldImpact: On a flaky router the board looks healthy for a minute while an order is missing.

title: A kitchen hand sees far more customer personal data than he needs to cook
steps: Read the Dashboard landing, Customers, Orders
expected: Kitchen role sees first name, items, allergens, notes, fulfilment type
actual: Landing page lists recent orders with customer names and emails; Customers page lists all customers with emails/phones; Orders shows all shops; kitchen API payload carries email, phone, delivery address, totals, payment method
realWorldImpact: Data-minimisation (UK GDPR Art 5(1)(c)) gap; a casual worker can photograph a customer list.

title: Delivery and collection orders look identical on the kitchen screen
steps: Place a delivery order and a collection order
actual: Screen card text has no fulfilment marker (only the printed ticket has one)
realWorldImpact: Delivery food packed for the counter or vice versa.

title: Kitchen board is hard to read at arm's length on a tablet
expected: Large item text; tickets dominate the screen
actual: Line items 14px; permanent 256px admin sidebar at 768 and 1024; an 'All shops' info box on every load; 'ALLERGENS' heading clipped at the card edge; print button overhangs the card
realWorldImpact: Cook has to walk up to the tablet; slower service.

title: Hard offline is handled honestly and catches up instantly
steps: Kitchen open; go offline 60 s; place+confirm an order meanwhile; reconnect
expected: Board says it's offline and catches up
actual: 'Offline — no live order feed' banner with last-updated time within 5 s; missed order on the board 1 s after reconnect
realWorldImpact: Staff know when not to trust the screen — keep this.

title: Sign-out on the shared tablet really ends the session
actual: Back shows sign-in; Keycloak form has empty username and needs a password; next person signed in as themselves
realWorldImpact: No accidental shift under the previous person's identity — keep this.

title: Allergen banner and per-line chips are unmissable; money/GDPR endpoints refuse a non-admin
steps: Call refund/finance/GDPR/approvals with the staff token
actual: Brown ALLERGENS banner + per-item chips; refund/finance/GDPR/approvals all 403
realWorldImpact: Core safety and money walls hold — keep these.
